requirementSections.heading: Supporting Courses and Related Areas

rules.commentRaw: In this option, the student shall submit a proposal to the adviser listing his/her choice of subjects beyond those required in the Supporting Courses and Related Areas category. In consultation with the adviser and the Multidisciplinary Arts, Social Sciences, Sciences, and Humanities program head, the student may choose from any B.A. course offering of the University. Option must be approved no later than the end of the sixth semester. (15 credits must be at the 400 level)
